# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Fixed the legacy process-parameter provenance migration so moved `_mg`/`_mg_total` `param_meta` entries now rewrite `unit` and scale `valid_range` alongside the value conversion to concentration units, added explicit provenance/confidence metadata for the remaining load-bearing decomposer and nitrifier rate/yield/decay controls plus `comammox_vmax_fraction` in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml`, documented the fixed `ATMOSPHERIC_CO2_PPM` boundary constant in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs`, updated `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` to surface the new kinetics coverage and atmospheric CO2 anchor, and added regression tests to lock the migrated metadata normalization and expanded shipped kinetics metadata in place.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the pending amendments against the current tree, confirmed the legacy `param_meta` migration bug and missing kinetics provenance were in scope for this bead, and isolated the alkalinity-budget unit-safety complaint as a separate-worktree follow-up rather than touching the user's dirty `.claude` worktree.
1. [Completed] Patched `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` so legacy process `param_meta` migrations now normalize canonical units and scale `valid_range` bounds with the same concentration transform used for the numeric parameter values.
2. [Completed] Extended `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs`, and `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` with provenance/confidence coverage for decomposer and nitrifier biomass-rate controls and the fixed atmospheric CO2 boundary anchor so future tuning work can see which kinetics remain provisional.
3. [Completed] Added regression coverage for transformed legacy metadata and shipped biomass-rate metadata, then ran formatting and package tests.
4. [Skipped] Skipped the alkalinity-budget refactor in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` because it is not part of this bead and the worktree already had unrelated user changes.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_data` passed with 41 tests green, including `presets::tests::test_process_preset_parser_migrates_legacy_nitrogen_param_meta_range_units`, `presets::tests::test_process_preset_parser_migrates_legacy_algae_half_saturation_param_meta_keys`, and `presets::tests::shipped_process_biomass_rate_controls_have_provenance_metadata`.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed across unit and integration suites, including `tests::process_preset_mapping_carries_denitrification_fields`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across 102 unit tests and all integration suites; the run emitted one pre-existing unused-import warning in `tests/source_water_carbonate.rs`.

## Outstanding Risks

- `soft_acidic.toml` and `ro_like.toml` still do not carry per-parameter `param_meta` entries.
- Substrate provenance coverage is still partial beyond representative `colonizable_area_factor` annotations; other substrate indices and nutrient-charge fields remain unannotated.
- Code-resident carbonate constants still rely on doc comments plus `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` until the project adds a dedicated metadata registry for shared chemistry constants.
- The alkalinity budget unit-safety concern called out in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` remains unresolved because it lives in a separate already-dirty worktree and is outside this bead's provenance-focused scope.
